text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a research article focused on long-term hydroclimatic projections and climate change impacts on water resources and agriculture in Morocco. There is no indication of explicit LULC future predictions or spatially explicit LULC modeling with accuracy metrics. The scale is national but the focus is on water yield and economic impacts, not LULC change modeling. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria requiring primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation.)
